## Purpose

Describe the problem and the user or research value of this change.

## Determinism and compatibility

- [ ] Event ordering and random streams are unchanged, or the change is explained.
- [ ] Trace-schema additions or breaks are documented.
- [ ] Exported APIs and compatibility implications are documented.

## Verification

- [ ] `gofmt -w .`
- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Relevant benchmarks or reproducibility tests were run.
